transcript.speaker: Seb
transcript.text: Well, anyway, I think we should try it out in our maths teaching practice with Year 3. I can see using origami is a really engaging way of reinforcing children’s knowledge of geometric shapes, like they were doing in the video, but I think it would also work really well for presenting fractions, which is coming up soon.

transcript.speaker: Lia
transcript.text: Good idea – that’s something most of the kids in that class might struggle with. Origami would also be good practice for using symmetry - but I think they did that last term.

transcript.speaker: Seb
transcript.text: OK – well let’s try and get some ideas together and plan the lesson next week.
